cards.card_text: They ask Moses: who of all flesh has heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the fire, like they have, and survived?
cards.verse_text: For who of all flesh has heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the fire, as we have, and survived?

cards.card_text: And all flesh will know the LORD is the one who drew it.
cards.verse_text: Then all flesh will know that I, the LORD, have taken My sword from its sheath, not to return it again.’ But you, son of man, groan! Groan before their eyes with a broken heart and bitter grief.
